اغتلمت (form VIII)
# اِغْتَلَمْتُ (iḡtalamtu) /iɣ.ta.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
# اِغْتَلَمْتَ (iḡtalamta) /iɣ.ta.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
# اِغْتَلَمْتِ (iḡtalamti) /iɣ.ta.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَلَمَ (iḡtalama)
# اِغْتَلَمَتْ (iḡtalamat) /iɣ.ta.la.mat/: third-perso
